candidate_sentences.text: The group delivered record financial performance in 2024, reporting a net profit of EUR 150.3 million, an increase of 7 percent compared to the prior year.
This improvement was driven by robust top-line growth, with total net income reaching EUR 338.3 million, an 11 percent rise.

Net interest income grew by 8 percent to EUR 273.3 million, while net fee and commission income surged by 24 percent to EUR 60.3 million, reflecting heightened customer activity and broader service adoption.
Operating expenses rose by 14 percent to EUR 146.9 million, primarily due to workforce expansion, resulting in a cost-to-income ratio of 43.4 percent.

verified_key_information_units.information: The loan portfolio expanded by EUR 990 million (28% YoY) to EUR 4.6 billion, comprising Estonian corporate loans up 21% to EUR 2.3 billion, Estonian retail loans up 21% to EUR 1.9 billion, and UK SME loans up 338% to EUR 0.3 billion.

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically support the overall narrative of record financial performance in 2024. Explanations (S3-S4) show clear cause-effect relationships for profit growth and cost increases. Strategic developments (S9-S11, S14) are presented as drivers of results without contradiction. Balance sheet growth (S5-S7) aligns with income statement improvements (S1-S4). The mention of interest rate decline (S13) and mitigation measures (S14) forms a logical risk-management narrative. Organizational flow moves from consolidated results to segment highlights to strategic actions. No material contradictions, logical gaps, or unnecessary repetitions are present. The summary forms a coherent whole describing growth drivers, operational metrics, and strategic positioning.
